entity.description: One latest case; capture-time history is not backfilled.

nodes.name: stg_lca
nodes.description: One file release/hash/source-row; original payload retained. LCA is an application, not approval or a sponsorship promise. Annual wage assumes 2080h/52wk/26biweekly/12mo.

create table "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."fact_lca_case" as

with winners as (
 select * from "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_lca_case_candidates"
 where nullif(trim(case_number),?) is not null
 qualify row_number() over(partition by case_number order by winner_rank)=?
), history as (
 select w.case_number,count(d.employer_key) as matching_versions,max(d.employer_key) as employer_key
 from winners w left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_employer" d
 on w.employer_id=d.employer_id and d.valid_from<=cast(w.decision_date as timestamp)
 and (d.valid_to is null or d.valid_to>=cast(w.decision_date as timestamp)+interval ?)
 group by w.case_number
), first_capture as (
 select employer_id,min(valid_from) as first_valid_from from "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_employer" group by employer_id
)
select w.case_number,w.case_status,w.case_status like ? as is_certified,
 w.visa_class,w.job_title,w.employer_name as source_employer_name,w.source_employer_key,
 w.employer_id,case when h.matching_versions=? then h.employer_key end as employer_key,
 case when w.employer_id is null then ?
 when w.decision_date is null then ?
 when cast(w.decision_date as timestamp)+interval ?<=f.first_valid_from then ?
 when h.matching_versions=? then ?
 else ? end as employer_history_status,
 ? as fact_time_precision,w.occupation_key,w.geography_key,
 d.date_key as decision_date_key,w.decision_date,w.received_date,w.begin_date,w.end_date,
 w.soc_code_raw,w.soc_code,w.occupation_mapping_status,w.county_mapping_status,
 w.wage_amount,w.wage_unit,cast(w.annual_wage as decimal(?,?)) as annual_wage,
 cast(w.worker_positions as decimal(?,?)) as worker_positions,
 w.source_system,w.source_release,w.source_sha256,w.source_url,w.source_row_number,w.fiscal_year,
 w.worksite_state,
 cast(w.source_occurrence_count as bigint) as source_occurrence_count,
 case when w.chronological_tie_count>? then ? else ? end as latest_selection_status
from winners w join history h using(case_number)
left join first_capture f on w.employer_id=f.employer_id
left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_date" d on w.decision_date=d.calendar_date

create table "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_lca_case_candidates" as

select l.*,m.employer_id,m.occupation_key,m.geography_key,
 m.occupation_mapping_status,m.county_mapping_status,
 count(*) over(partition by l.case_number) as source_occurrence_count,
 count(*) over(partition by l.case_number,l.decision_date,l.received_date,l.fiscal_year) as chronological_tie_count,
 row_number() over(partition by l.case_number order by
 l.decision_date desc nulls last,l.received_date desc nulls last,l.fiscal_year desc,
 l.source_release desc,l.source_sha256,l.source_row_number) as winner_rank
from "fy2025-full"."FACTS_INPUT"."lca" l
left join "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_dimension_mapping" m
 on l.source_system=m.source_system and l.source_release=m.source_release
 and l.source_sha256=m.source_sha256 and l.source_row_number=m.source_row_number

create table "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_lca_case_candidates" as

select l.*,m.employer_id,m.occupation_key,m.geography_key,
 m.occupation_mapping_status,m.county_mapping_status,
 count(*) over(partition by l.case_number) as source_occurrence_count,
 count(*) over(partition by l.case_number,l.decision_date,l.received_date,l.fiscal_year) as chronological_tie_count,
 row_number() over(partition by l.case_number order by
 l.decision_date desc nulls last,l.received_date desc nulls last,l.fiscal_year desc,
 l.source_release desc,l.source_sha256,l.source_row_number) as winner_rank
from "fy2025-full"."FACTS_INPUT"."lca" l
left join "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_dimension_mapping" m
 on l.source_system=m.source_system and l.source_release=m.source_release
 and l.source_sha256=m.source_sha256 and l.source_row_number=m.source_row_number
create table FACTS_INPUT.lca as select * from original.STAGING.stg_lca

create table "fy2025-full"."INTERMEDIATE"."int_dimension_mapping" as

select l.*,
 o.occupation_key, g.geography_key, x.employer_id,
 case when l.soc_code_raw is null or trim(l.soc_code_raw) = ? then ?
      when l.soc_code is null then ?
      when o.occupation_key is null then ?
      else ? end as occupation_mapping_status,
 case when l.geography_status not in (?,?,?) then l.geography_status
      when g.geography_key is null then ?
      else ? end as county_mapping_status,
 g.cbsa_status,
 case when x.employer_id is null then ?
      when first_snapshot.first_valid_from is null then ?
      when l.decision_date is null then ?
      when l.decision_date < first_snapshot.first_valid_from then ?
      else ? end as employer_history_status
from "fy2025-full"."DIMENSIONS_INPUT"."lca_attributes" l
left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_occupation" o on l.soc_code = o.soc_code and o.soc_vintage = ?
left join "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_geography" g
 on l.county_fips = g.county_fips and l.geography_vintage = g.county_reference_vintage
left join "fy2025-full"."DIMENSIONS_INPUT"."employer_sources" x
 on l.source_system = x.source_system and l.source_employer_key = x.source_employer_key
left join (select employer_id,min(valid_from) as first_valid_from from "fy2025-full"."MARTS"."dim_employer" group by employer_id) first_snapshot
 on x.employer_id = first_snapshot.employer_id
